questionText:
which word fills the blank in this research-library passage?

•      cycle-aware _____ supports hormonal transitions
•      certain nutrients may reduce bloating, pain, and fatigue
•      hydration and anti-inflammatory foods support recovery processes
•      balanced meals stabilize blood sugar + mood
nutrients to prioritize during menstruation
•      iron → replenishes blood loss + supports energy
•      magnesium → relaxes muscles + supports nervous system
•      omega-3 fatty acids → reduce inflammatory signaling
•      fiber → supports digestion + metabolic stability
•      hydration → regulates fluid balance
foods that may support menstrual comfort
•     legumes (beans, lentils): iron, magnesium, fiber
